name: knn
description: A K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) classifier and regressor. Features Euclidean, Manhattan, and Cosine distance metrics, support for custom value weighting (uniform or distance-inverse), feature standardization scaling, and predictions for both discrete classes and continuous values.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a classic non-parametric classification or regression model (KNN) without external libraries like scikit-learn.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Number of nearest neighbors to look at.

parameters.name: distanceMetric
parameters.description: The distance metric to use: 'euclidean', 'manhattan', or 'cosine'.

parameters.name: standardize
parameters.description: If true, normalizes input features to mean=0 and variance=1 based on training data statistics.
